posts.description: Active recall == "Questions that force you to think" Active recall questions do not necessarily need an answer . posts.title: Error Messages in Internal Tools: Patterns and Lessons Learned
posts.description: Bad error messages will increase the load on support teams With good error messages, users can solve their own problems without resorting to support. Bad error messages mean that every problem becomes a ticket on internal support, costing money and time. posts.title: The Tell-tale Sign of Great Product Management
posts.description: The tell-tale sign of great product management is that it seems to read your mind .
